## Description
The pinned, source-bound Full E2E for automated [Staging Convergence PR #3192](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/3192) failed at [Run #42818385173](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/42818385173): `project-session-create.spec.ts:130`, Chromium 390px, `Expected <= 2`, `Received 40` on all three attempts.

## Root Cause
A **stale browser assertion** following accepted choice-list design #3164. The old test demands the popup always equal its trigger width. The canonical `design/contracts/patterns/choice-item.json` permits resource/rich-choice content to grow wider than the narrow trigger, while still requiring popup >= trigger and no horizontal overflow, anchored within the viewport. The actual production `SelectContent width="content"` implementation follows that design. This is a test-contract contradiction, not proof of UI failure.

## Reproduction
Run source-bound Full E2E on #3192 integration head `bc52697afc2a272cde3dea8d9a9589b0be8ff3ac` and inspect long-path existing-location test at 390px. The width difference is consistently 40 CSS pixels.

## Impact
A correctly fail-closed Full E2E blocks automated Staging merge of source revisions even though this single equality assertion contradicts the approved resource-choice width contract. Do not skip the test or waive Full.

## Fix Direction
Replace only the obsolete exact-equality assertion with the design requirement popup width >= trigger (± pixel rounding) and popup left >= viewport left, retaining existing right-edge containment, no horizontal document overflow, long-path wrapping, option bounds, content-sized trigger and keyboard/selection checks. Run the existing exact-head browser test and selected E2E. When staging parent changes, the convergence controller must supersede the old pinned PR rather than accept stale Full.

## Location
`e2e/tests/browser/project-session-create.spec.ts`.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 The real Project Existing Location long-path scenario at 1440/1180/1024/390 verifies the #3164 resource-popup geometry and existing content/interaction invariants; authenticated exact-head E2E passes with no changed feature implementation or weakened gate.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01 = SCN-02 real Chromium browser regression on the PR head; independently verify the changed assertion against `design/contracts/patterns/choice-item.json`. Runner is existing `E2E / Tests`; no new test runner.
